pkgmetadata.longdescription: The official Claude desktop application from Anthropic, repackaged from the upstream Debian binary package. It bundles its own Electron runtime and provides the Chat, Cowork and Claude Code tabs: parallel sessions, visual diff review, an integrated terminal and editor, and live app preview. Linux support is a beta from upstream.

use.flag: Install the bundled chrome-sandbox helper setuid root. Only needed on kernels without CONFIG_USER_NS, or where unprivileged user namespaces are blocked by a sysctl or an LSM. Otherwise leave this off: the bundled Chromium uses its namespace sandbox, which needs no elevated privileges at all.
